newsHighlights.title: OPC+ Wins 2026 Future Tech Award
newsHighlights.titleZh: OPC+ 榮獲 2026 未來科技獎
newsHighlights.description:
Honored to share that OPC+ has received a 2026 Future Tech Award from Taiwan's National Science and Technology Council, in the Semiconductor / Photonics / Communications category.

OPC+ is, to our knowledge, the world's first universal cloud OPC platform spanning i-line, KrF, and ArF lithography — and natively correcting freeform designs like silicon photonics, metalenses, and metasurfaces from a single GPU-accelerated engine (>50× over CPU). The goal is simple: make professional-grade mask correction accessible to the fabs, fabless teams, silicon-photonics startups, and universities that can't afford multi-million-dollar EDA seats.

This is a team milestone — my thanks to co-PIs Prof. Shie-Yuan Wang, Prof. Jhih-Sheng Wu and our talented students across NYCU's Photonics and Computer Science departments, TSRI for the KrF tapeout that took this from algorithm to silicon, and NSTC Taiwan Chip-based Industrial Innovation Program for Funding support .

More to come.
newsHighlights.descriptionZh:
很榮幸與大家分享——OPC+ 榮獲 2026 未來科技獎（國家科學及技術委員會主辦），入選半導體與光電通訊領域。

OPC+ 是全球首個橫跨 i-line／KrF／ArF 光學微影製程的通用雲端光罩修正平台，並以單一 GPU 加速引擎（較 CPU 逾 50 倍）原生支援矽光子、超穎透鏡與超穎表面等自由曲線設計。我們的目標很單純：讓中小型晶圓廠、無晶圓設計團隊、矽光子新創與學研單位，也能用得起專業級的光罩修正。

這是一整個團隊的成果——感謝共同主持人 王協源教授、吳致盛助理教授，感謝陽明交大光電系與資訊系一群優秀的學生，也感謝 TSRI 完成 KrF 流片驗證，讓演算法真正走到矽晶圓上，以及國科會晶創EDA計畫的經費支持。

後續還有更多進展，敬請期待。

newsHighlights.title: Optics Express Editor's Pick: High-Contrast EUV Imaging with Topological Quasi Phase-Only Masks
newsHighlights.titleZh: 《Optics Express》編輯精選：拓撲準相位光罩實現高對比EUV成像
newsHighlights.description: Our paper "High-contrast EUV imaging enabled by topological quasi phase-only masks" has been selected as an Editor's Pick in Optics Express — congratulations to lead author Po-Hsun Fang and the team at NYCU and at TSMC. EUV lithography keeps running into the same wall: the low-k₁ resolution limit. This work pushes through it from two directions. (1) A new kind of EUV mask: instead of relying on absorption, we use a low-n / low-k, Mo-based quasi phase-only mask that modulates phase to lift image contrast and NILS beyond what conventional absorber masks allow — while staying compatible with existing fab processes. (2) A fast inverse-design (ILT) flow: topological phase-mask patterns are only useful if you can actually synthesize them, so we built an inverse-design pipeline that makes these masks practical to generate, not just to theorize. Grateful to the TSMC EBO department for their collaboration and insight throughout this work.
newsHighlights.descriptionZh: 我們的論文《High-contrast EUV imaging enabled by topological quasi phase-only masks》獲選為《Optics Express》編輯精選（Editor’s Pick）——恭喜第一作者方柏勛與陽明交大／台積電團隊。EUV微影長年卡在同一道牆：低k₁解析度極限。這次的工作從兩個方向把它推穿。（一）一種新的EUV光罩：不再只靠吸收，而是用低n／低k、以鉬（Mo）為基礎的「準相位型光罩（quasi phase-only mask）」，透過相位調制把影像對比與NILS推到傳統吸收型光罩做不到的區間，同時保持與現有製程的相容性。（二）一套快速的逆向設計（ILT）流程：拓撲相位光罩再漂亮，做不出來就只是理論。我們建立了逆向設計管線，讓這類光罩從「可想像」變成「可合成」。感謝台積電EBO部門在整個研究過程中的合作與洞見。
